messages.subject: Meridian Trade Park, Coventry - instruction
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Following our call, we'd like to instruct Whitfield Carter on the acquisition of Meridian Trade Park in Coventry - the multi-let industrial estate I mentioned (nine units, one currently void). We've agreed heads in principle with the seller, Hartside Estates, at £14.75m. Pennine Business Bank are lined up for the senior debt at around 60% LTV.

Can you send your engagement terms and get a team on it? We'd like to push for exchange before Christmas.

Marcus

messages.subject: RE: Meridian Trade Park, Coventry - instruction
messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus,

Delighted to act. Our engagement letter is attached - please sign and return the copy. James Osei (copied) will be your day-to-day contact, with Elena Marchetti supporting; I'll oversee.

We'll get conflict checks and AML underway today and request the data room access from Castle & Vane, who I understand are acting for Hartside. A pre-Christmas exchange is achievable if the title and searches are clean.

Best,
Sarah

--
Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
